items.text: U.S. officials warned Ukraine and European allies they could suspend intelligence sharing and PURL weapons buys if Kyiv keeps striking Russian energy sites.
items.detail: CNN reported Monday that State Department and Pentagon warnings went out over the weekend, confirming an earlier Financial Times account; a NATO official said PURL supplies were still flowing Monday. PURL is the Europe-funded channel for buying U.S. weapons for Ukraine, including scarce Patriot interceptors. The White House declined comment. The pressure followed President Trump's announced energy ceasefire and his criticism of President Zelensky.
items.why: Cutting intelligence and Patriot supply would immediately weaken Ukraine's air defense.

items.text: The EU sanctioned nearly 1,600 Russian companies and executives in its largest listings package aimed at Moscow's military industry.
items.detail: The Council adopted 1,569 listings — 826 companies and 743 CEOs — targeting mid-level suppliers of electronics, missiles, drones and aircraft parts; more than half address ballistic-missile production. Listed people face asset freezes and EU travel bans, and the Ukraine territorial-integrity sanctions list now totals nearly 4,600. Separately the same day, the Council listed 77 people over illegal Russian State Duma elections in occupied Ukrainian territory.
items.why: The biggest EU listing round since 2022 raises pressure on Russia's war industry as Washington eases energy sanctions on Moscow.

items.text: Evernorth Holdings began Nasdaq trading as XRPN, the first pure-play publicly listed XRP treasury company.
items.detail: Yahoo Finance marked XRPN newly listed effective Oct. 12; shares opened at $16.68, ranged from $16.39 to $19.39, and closed at $16.91 on about 1.28 million shares. Evernorth closed its Armada Acquisition Corp. II merger on Oct. 9 and says it holds about 473 million XRP with roughly $300 million in gross cash proceeds. Warrants trade as XRPNW.
items.why: Turns a closely watched crypto SPAC into a traded XRP-treasury stock on a federal holiday.
